description:
Make room for what you want to get done.

Capture ideas, plan everyday tasks, and break larger activities into manageable steps. Together brings your tasks, recurring plans, and completion history into a focused iPhone experience.

PLAN YOUR DAY
Browse tasks by date, set times and reminders, and manage overdue items.

BREAK THINGS DOWN
Add notes and subtasks to turn an idea into clear next steps.

KEEP RECURRING PLANS
Set a schedule for tasks that repeat and manage them in a dedicated view.

TURN NOTES INTO TASKS
Take a photo, select an image, or paste text. Review and edit the resulting draft before adding tasks.

LOOK BACK AT YOUR PROGRESS
Explore completed tasks, scheduling changes, and reviews of the current week or month.

STAY CLOSE TO YOUR TASKS
See tasks in Home Screen widgets and follow a task with a Live Activity.

PERSONAL DATA AND PREFERENCES
Use iCloud sync and restore, light and dark appearance, and app locking.

This version focuses on personal task management. Two-person collaboration and in-app purchase entry points have been removed.
promotionalText: Turn ideas into action. Organize everyday and recurring tasks, review drafts from paper notes, and look back at your plans and completed work.
whatsNew:
A redesigned personal task experience:
• Updated task lists, recurring tasks, and editing screens.
• Import photos or pasted text and review drafts before adding tasks.
• Explore task history and weekly or monthly execution reviews.
• Updated widgets and task Live Activities.
• Personal sync and restore with iCloud.
• Removed two-person collaboration and in-app purchase entry points.
